name: logo_fatal
notes: prints "LABS.EXE Version 1.32" and "ERROR: msg", exit(-1)

name: text_clear_b800
notes: fills B800:0000, 7D00h words, with 0

name: pal_set
notes: DAC write: port 3C8=0, 256x3 bytes to 3C9 (6-bit)

name: pal_get
notes: DAC read: 3C7=0, 256x3 from 3C9

name: set_video_mode
notes: INT 10h AH=0

name: bios_ticks
notes: 0040:006C dword (18.2 Hz BIOS tick count)

name: huge_alloc
notes: DOS alloc (bytes>>4)+1 paragraphs; NULL on failure

name: huge_free
notes: DOS free

name: huge_fread
type: uint32_t huge_fread(FILE *f, void far *dst, uint32_t n)
notes: reads in 512-byte chunks, normalising the far pointer

name: ss_load
notes: .SS loader ("MADSS1"); name without extension; merges the sprite palette into pal768; error code in [0C74] 1..5; see frontend.md 2.3

name: ss_free
notes: frees the series

name: ss_draw
type: void ss_draw(SS far *s, int frame, int x, int y, Screen scr)
notes: x==3E7h or y==3E7h -> frame own x,y; key-colour blit (value FCh skipped); Screen = {h=200,w=320,off=0,seg=A000h}

name: ss_remap_rows_a
notes: adds base-1 to every non-FCh pixel (row markers F9/FE/FF)

name: ss_remap_rows_b
notes: second variant of the same walk (FA/FD/FC grammar)

name: ovl_load_log
notes: overlay loader (RE_GUIDE 2.2); returns load segment, 0 on failure; used for ?SOUND.LOG

name: ovl_bind_log
notes: fills 7-byte JMP FAR thunks at 00DA:0049+7*slot (slot base 100); entries from header +32h, cseg +28h, n +30h

name: ovl_free_log
notes: INT 21h/49h

name: snd_init_log
notes: thunk to LOG slot 100; main repeats until AX==0

name: snd_cmd_log
notes: thunk to LOG slot 101; 2 = play jingle, 0 = stop

name: snd_shutdown_log
notes: thunk to LOG slot 102

name: setup_main
notes: text-mode configuration; exit(24h) = configured, exit(0) = abort

name: break_check
notes: if Ctrl-Break flag [0AC8] set -> exit(0)

name: text_gotoxy
notes: INT 10h AH=2 (via int86 0x1387)

name: setup_exit
notes: break_hook_remove, release MISC overlay, timer_remove if installed, exit(code)

name: wait_ticks
notes: timer_install; wait until [0782] > n; timer_remove ([0782] is bumped by the timer tick)

name: ovl_load
notes: overlay loader (RE_GUIDE 2.2), returns segment

name: text_puts_at
type: void text_puts_at(int row, int col, char *s)
notes: BIOS teletype writer; byte FFh in the string switches the attribute to the next byte (kept in cs:14BD)

name: dos_puts
notes: INT 21h AH=9 ($-terminated)

name: mouse_present
notes: INT 33h/0 after checking the vector is neither 0 nor IRET; 1 if the driver answers FFFFh

name: joy_calib_center
notes: joy_read_raw then both axes: centre := min := max := raw

name: joy_calib_track
notes: joy_read_raw then joy_scale for X and Y (widens min/max, writes scaled 0..FF to DS:E24/E25)

name: joy_calib_get
notes: copies the 28h-byte calibration block (DS:0DF4) to comm+48h

name: player_main
notes: argv[1..] = .PAN names without extension; usage text "player pan_file(s)"

name: player_init
notes: allocates all free memory (>= 2000h paragraphs) as ring buffer, comm=[0:4F0], binds sound, timer_install, video mode 13h only if not already 13h

name: player_run
notes: loop poll_input until all cels are shown; if argc>2 waits for snd_cmd(2)==0; then player_exit(0)

name: player_exit
notes: snd_cmd(0), restore INT 8/1B/23, video mode restore (only if it was not 13h), free buffer, exit(code)

name: pan_play_file
notes: name + ".PAN"; streams/decodes (LZ bit stream, RE_GUIDE 4) into the ring buffer while the tick callback consumes cels

name: break_hooks_install
notes: INT 1Bh and INT 23h -> ISR 0560 (sets [2092]=3)

name: poll_input
notes: first call starts the sound (snd_cmd 3) and arms the tick callback ([1E7A]:=0); polls joystick buttons 0/1 (comm+72h bit 0), mouse buttons (bit 1), keyboard; any input -> player_exit(key or 1Bh)

name: tick_callback
notes: called from the timer ISR each tick: fade step, or countdown [1DEA] then cel_show; ++[1DEE] tick counter; ++[1DF0] after the last cel

name: cel_show
notes: 'Z' header: speed -> [1DEC]=60/speed, palette (cel base - 768) loaded with the screen blanked, then fade in; 'B' cel: asserts bytes 42h,0,1,0; RLE-draws the delta onto A000 (1006); returns the next cel pointer

name: pan_decode_chunk
notes: LZ-stream decoder step (see tools/lzs.py)

name: pal_load
type: void pal_load(int first, int count, uint8_t far *rgb)
notes: writes DAC; while a fade is pending ([13D4]!=0) writes black and keeps the target palette in [13DA]

name: screen_off
notes: wait vblank; port 3C4 reg 1 |= 20h (screen off)

name: screen_on
notes: wait vblank; reg 1 &= ~20h

name: fade_init
notes: steps = |secs|*60 -> [13D4]; builds per-tick colour slice from the vblank-measured loop speed

name: fade_step
notes: writes one slice of the scaled palette, --[13D4]

name: cel_rle_draw
type: uint32_t cel_rle_draw(uint32_t src, unsigned dseg, unsigned doff)
notes: PAN cel RLE (RE_GUIDE 4): 00 n v fill, 1..7F literal, 81..FF skip, 80 w long op
